objective: Restore and protect all presently approved BUKLOD Android AdMob placements across Home, Wall, Reels, Profile, Connect inbox, Organization/Cluster, video companion, submission and content screens: responsive native/large creatives, durable banner re-entry, safe early interstitial preload and controlled rewarded inventory. Lock exact production Android OTA configuration so ad UI cannot silently disappear in later updates.
productionBaselineEvidence: Production telemetry read-only, November 7 2026 last 24h: Android AdMob 165 requests / 81 loaded / 42 provider impression events / 33 failures; 4 interstitial requests, 4 loaded, 0 provider impression events (interstitial OPENED is recorded as ad_rendered, not as ad_impression, so zero impressions alone does not prove zero presentations). Last 48h 38 Google no-fill codes, 35 generic AD_ERROR category and smaller network/internal errors. Source currently has 8-second Native/first-view/banner timeouts; on viewport exit native renderer tears down loaded NativeAd and shared 120-second cooldown can delay return. Home/Profile/Cluster/Wall and other placements have observed impressions, so advertising is not globally disabled. Live Expo/EAS production variable values and native on-device fill not independently verified.
chosenApproach: Preserve already-loaded NativeAd/BannerAd state on mounted offscreen/re-entry and short network blips, keep initial viewport and consent eligibility and single SDK request reservation. Permit slightly longer bounded timeouts on weak links; keep 2-minute anti-no-fill cooldown and collapsed empty slots. Explicitly permit passive Focus sponsor on Faculty landing only, not related grade/exam screens or fullscreen. Preserve narrow Android header while allowing safe wide/tablet header sponsor. Early preload a single interstitial on an eligible Android content route after remote feature flags loaded and on app resume, but never show on app launch/route navigation; only existing server-confirmed natural break >= two actions may show. Recover stale SDK instance after failed show and fail-closed on unreadable Ad-Light Pass. Add a secret-safe EAS production environment check before Android RC export to require live mode and required banner, Native and interstitial unit inventory. Expand existing production OTA ad regression harness.
selectionRationale: High ad request activity and 42 impressions disprove a total SDK outage. Native offscreen disposal and short 8-second timeouts can suppress loaded/slow ads while preserving user privacy and Google no-fill. Existing event-driven interstitials need prewarming, not unconditional popping that violates AdMob. Current production workflow tests runtime source but does not verify real production ad environment; this enables silent test-mode/missing-unit exports. No new native module/build is needed for the targeted fixes.
alternativeApproaches: Force test unit or hardcode live publisher IDs into the app (rejected: invalid production traffic and credential management)
Show an interstitial on every user action, app startup, SOS, active calls or exam submission (rejected: prohibited disruptive/accidental-click placements and violates app safety)
Immediately auto-retry every AdMob no-fill (rejected: no new inventory, increased invalid request pressure)
Keep all loaded ads in an unbounded global cache after component unmount (rejected: native SDK object lifecycle/memory growth)
Replace current native/ad fallback components with a new monetization SDK (rejected: high regression risk and requires a new APK)

No 0px placeholders for initial viewport: keep measurable 8px probes; no large empty sponsored panels if no fill
